競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 糖尿病事業を分離した新会社。分離関連の契約でメドトロニックに依存
relations.text_en: Spun off from Medtronic's diabetes business; relies on separation agreements with it

source.label: MiniMed Group 10-K(2026年4月期)
source.quote: Medtronic may fail to perform under various transaction agreements entered into in connection with the Separation

companies.name: オーケストラ・バイオメド

relations.text: 高血圧治療AVIMの独占ライセンス・共同開発契約
relations.text_en: Exclusive license and collaboration for AVIM therapy

source.label: Orchestra BioMed 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have an exclusive license and collaboration agreement with Medtronic, Inc.

companies.name: アンテリス・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: メドトロニックが2026年1月に出資、同社は主な競合でもある
relations.text_en: Medtronic bought shares in January 2026; also a primary competitor

source.label: Anteris Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 20, 2026, we entered into a stock purchase agreement with Covidien Group S.à r.l. ("Covidien"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Medtronic plc

relations.text: 主な競合にメドトロニックを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Medtronic among its primary competitors

source.label: Anteris Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include Edwards Lifesciences Corporation and Medtronic.

companies.name: アキュータス・メディカル

relations.text: 左心系アクセス製品をメドトロニックに売却し、製造・供給も担う
relations.text_en: Sold its left-heart access portfolio to Medtronic and supplies it under a distribution agreement

source.label: Acutus Medical 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In April 2022, we announced that we agreed to sell our left-heart access product portfolio to Medtronic pursuant to an Asset Purchase Agreement with Medtronic

companies.name: インスパイア・メディカル

relations.text: 2007年にメドトロニックから特許の譲渡とライセンスを受けた
relations.text_en: Received patents and a license from Medtronic in 2007

source.label: Inspire Medical 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In 2007, we entered into an assignment and license agreement with Medtronic ("the Assignment and License Agreement") pursuant to which Medtronic assigned certain patents and trademarks to us

relations.text: メドトロニックとダヴィータが腎臓ケアの新会社を設立(2023年)
relations.text_en: Medtronic and DaVita launched a new kidney care company in 2023

source.label: Outset Medical 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: in April 2023, Medtronic and DaVita launched a new independent company focused on kidney care

relations.text: メドトロニックとクロスライセンス契約を結び、同社DBSとも競合
relations.text_en: Cross-license with Medtronic; also competes with its DBS system

source.label: NeuroPace 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On July 27, 2005, we entered into a cross-license agreement, or the Cross-License, with Medtronic, Inc.

companies.name: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンス

relations.text: 経カテーテル弁(TAVR)の主な競合

source.label: Edwards Lifesciences 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In TAVR, our primary competitors include Medtronic plc ("Medtronic"), Abbott Laboratories ("Abbott"), and Boston Scientific Corporation.

relations.text: インスリンポンプ市場の主な競合

source.label: Insulet 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We compete with companies that produce insulin pumps, such as Medtronic and Tandem.

companies.name: タンデム・ダイアベティス・ケア

relations.text: インスリン投与機器の主な競合
relations.text_en: Key competitor in insulin delivery devices

source.label: Tandem Diabetes Care 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We compete in markets worldwide with companies that manufacture insulin delivery devices, primarily Beta Bionics, Insulet, Medtronic, mylife (formerly Ypsomed) and Sequel.

companies.name: ベータ・バイオニクス

relations.text: インスリンポンプの主な競合

source.label: Beta Bionics 10-K/A(2024年度)
source.quote: We primarily compete with a number of companies that manufacture and sell insulin pumps, such as Medtronic, Tandem, and Insulet.

source.label: Senseonics 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We compete with well-capitalized companies, some of which are publicly traded, that manufacture CGM systems including Dexcom, Medtronic and Abbott.

relations.text: 脊髄刺激装置の主な競合

source.label: Nevro 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Currently, our major competitors are Medtronic, Boston Scientific and Abbott Laboratories, who have obtained regulatory approval for SCS systems.

relations.text: 機械弁や胸部大動脈製品の競合
relations.text_en: Competitor in mechanical valves and thoracic aortic products

source.label: Artivion 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The E-vita Thoracic 3G competes primarily with products from Medtronic, Gore, Terumo, and Cook.
